summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TikTok-style impossible tasks app. Backend APIs fully functional (11/11 tests passed). Frontend core functionality working with one UI interaction issue identified.

ui_bugs.issue: Share button not clickable due to Emergent badge overlay interception
ui_bugs.details: The 'Made with Emergent' badge (position: x=1726, y=1024) is intercepting pointer events, preventing share button clicks

passed_tests: Backend: All 12 tasks API endpoints working (GET /api/tasks)
Frontend: App loads and displays first task (Hold)
Frontend: Stats overlay shows pass rate, tries, global attempts
Frontend: Task counter shows correct navigation (1/12, 2/12, etc.)
Frontend: Swipe up navigation works (Hold → Still → Catch → Tap 50 → Balance)
Frontend: Multiple task types render correctly (Hold, Still, Catch, Tap 50, Balance)
Frontend: Deep link URL format /task/{taskId} works correctly (tested /task/static_tap)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix share button overlay issue: The Emergent badge is intercepting pointer events and preventing the share button from being clickable. Need to adjust z-index or pointer-events CSS for the badge to allow share functionality to work properly.
